three-postprocessing-smaa.reason: SMAA runs correctly through the facade (after two corpus img-stub fixes: data:-URL texture loads and on-load property dispatch) and is bit-identical on pure wireframe geometry (cases-f4c2-lines PASS_IDENTICAL, hashes 0xac9e1edc). On the stock example the brick texture leaves half-float scene-RT texel LSBs (texture-filtering) below the 8-bit output quantization; the SMAA edge threshold (0.1) flips 136 edge texels and the pass amplifies them into blend differences: 1024/76800 px differ, max channel delta 32, matching 98.6667% (band is 99%). Probes: pre-SMAA render bit-exact (0x710a8f34), area+search texture uploads bit-exact (0x5dbe640b), lines-only bit-exact (0xac9e1edc). Backend class: texture-filtering LSB beyond the d<=2/99% band (same class as three-postprocessing-advanced). Measured 2026-11-26, Apple M4 Pro, ANGLE Metal 9c6a64c9 vs Chrome/Chromium 133 real WebGL2, 320x240.
three-postprocessing-smaa.note: The pass itself is proven by cases-f4c2-lines (exact); the stock example keeps the texture-region limit visible.

three-postprocessing-3dlut.reason: The prepare pipeline materializes the example's LUT files as prebuilt J3LT binary containers (luts__*.jsrlut, diagnostic prebuiltLutBin) for the R1 widget runtime; the stock LUTCubeLoader/LUTImageLoader validate magic/size against the container bytes and reject them (THREE.LUTCubeLoader: Missing LUT_3D_SIZE information). Asset-lane work belongs to the prepare pipeline (triage class 'Texture-container parse on converted bytes', F2d); the LUTPass itself is proven by cases-f4c2-lut (exact).
